response: State paddy production was 100,260,000 quintals in 1993-94 and 176,240,000 quintals in 2024-25. The series is uneven rather than steady: it fell to 49,150,000 quintals in 2002-03 and to 89,020,000 quintals in 2015-16, and reached its highest level of 180,800,000 quintals in 2022-23, with 174,830,000 quintals in 2023-24.
